smoke.budget_basis: As MC-113 to MC-115: the earlier cards' real cost, scaled by what the smoke shows. On the same two smoke questions, MiMo's tokens over Qwen's (MC-115's smoke report 46d24a6b) were 0.138 in dsh (20,823 against 150,984), 3.189 in omp (91,066 against 28,556; MiMo called two tools at once on its first turn and one result was about 24,800 characters), 1.717 for B (237 against MC-114's 138) and 0.961 for C (149 against 155). MC-115's real mean tokens per attempt (Part M DSHF 102,964, OMPF 95,823, B 191; Part S DSHF 55,253, OMPF 57,355, C 155) times its attempt counts (492 per Part M arm, 800 per Part S arm) times those ratios: 310.0 million; x 1.5 = 465.1 million; rounded up: 470,000,000. One smoke attempt per cell makes the ratios rough; the guard only stops a runaway run.
